svg.text: A name panel perched on the rim of your wine glass, held up by a coin hanging inside it. It nods, wobbles and never falls.
nudged away: coin swings up, gravity pulls it back
at rest: CoM straight under the rim
side view, section through glass and card (guest on the right, outside the glass)
computed from the actual masses (300 gsm card, 1 RUB coin): potential well and ring-down
mass 4.9 g | CoM 15 mm below the rim, 0.0 mm off-axis | pitch period 0.58 s
different coin in the same pocket: 2 RUB leans 11 deg, 10 RUB 12 deg, 5 RUB 13 deg (still stable). No coin: panel tips off.
card 250 gsm: +5 deg lean; 350 gsm: -6 deg; sliding the coin 1 mm in its pocket trims ~2.5 deg. The guest can tune it.
The coin hangs 15-45 mm below the rim: above any normal wine level, clear of the glass wall at rest.
